sketches.mechanism: Borrow checker prevents simultaneous mutable references — you cannot hold two mutable borrows of the same value at once
sketches.resonance: You cannot change someone while someone else is already changing them; transformation demands singular devotion.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with no methods (a marker interface) — it declares identity without requiring any behavior
sketches.resonance: Some things ask nothing of you except that you say what you are.

sketches.mechanism: A void pointer can hold the address of anything but must be cast before it can be used — it remembers where something is without knowing what it is
sketches.resonance: Memory outlasts recognition: you can still point to what you can no longer name.
